name: binayak-skills
description: Agent Skills by Binayak Dotel: portable SKILL.md folders for Claude and other agents.

plugins.name: visual-notes
plugins.description: Turn any topic, document or rough notes into a hand-drawn-style one-page study sheet (sketchnote / cheat sheet / revision notes) as a printable A4 PDF.

plugins.name: conventional-commits
plugins.description: Write clear Conventional Commits style commit messages (typed subject, body, breaking-change and issue footers) from a diff, staged changes or a short description of the work.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Research a topic on the web and return a sourced fact brief: every claim with a link and an exact quote, legend kept apart from history, versions, disputes and myths flagged, plus a JSON block (research-brief/1) that apps can import and check.

plugins.name: dev-flow
plugins.description: A ticket lifecycle for AI coding agents that works in any repo without editing the skills: one-time project setup from stack packs, spec-to-ticket planning on GitHub Issues, take / implement / address / done, a design package made once by a strong model, and UI translated from its reference screens.
